method: DNS: malesthetic.pro, www.malesthetic.pro, mayaos.ru, www.mayaos.ru all resolve to 45.130.41.193 (Beget, nginx-reuseport/1.21.1).
ROOT evidence: read-only SSH listing of the Beget account (ls, find, stat, sha256sum, grep -o counts). No file written, moved or deleted.
ROUTE evidence: an HTTP HEAD request against every legacy bundle copy found on disk, plus GET of the canonical entry pages. No request to any PHP endpoint was made.
redaction: The canonical repository is PUBLIC. The exact file names and URLs of the reachable legacy copies are withheld from this file, because a list of them is a map for anyone who wants the old authority UI. They are held outside the repository and were reported to the owner directly. Digest prefixes are kept so a copy can be matched without being named.

sourceBackupsWithSecrets.finding: Proxy-source backups exist in a served directory. Every one probed returned 403, so they are NOT exposed on the evidence gathered. Names and paths are withheld.

legacyExecutableRelays.finding: Besides the live legacy relay, older relay copies with an executable extension are present in served directories on two hosts. None was requested: PRODUCTION EFFECTS FOR PROOF: 0. Names and paths are withheld.

unsafeLegacyRouteNotReachableThroughAnot.evidence: The canonical app entries are dark (maintenance), but 44 full legacy app bundles answer 200 as text/html at other URLs on the same hosts. Two of the mayaos.ru copies are BYTE-IDENTICAL to repository commits of app.html (2e7de86d, 33396c16) — the shipped PWA itself, reachable after its entry went dark.

roleModeUiCannotResurrectThroughAnOldBui.evidence: 603 role-mode tokens (ChooseVersion / __meCurMode) and 2,568 client-side authority tokens are served in those 44 copies.

noDirectProviderOrBusinessWritePathInARe.evidence: The served copies carry 1,237 relay/provider references, and the relays they call are present in the same docroots. Whether a given write would be accepted today was not exercised; presence alone fails a check whose condition is absence.

primaryMayaBundleUsesTheCertifiedWidgetP.evidence: No primary Maya bundle is served: both /app/ entries serve a 2,247-byte maintenance page. The successor source maya-chat-shell has no HTML entry, no DOM mount and no network client, so it cannot be served as it stands. 0 of 44 served copies reference /widgets/.

note: 404, 403 and maintenance responses were not taken as proof on their own. Each reading above is paired with the docroot listing that explains it.

lineage.method: sha256 of every served copy compared with the last 40 committed versions of each repository bundle
lineage.appHtml: 2 served copies byte-identical to committed app.html (2e7de86d, 33396c16)
lineage.mayaOsSiteIndexHtml: 0 served copies byte-identical to any of its last 40 committed versions. 30 served mayaos.ru copies from 2026-08-08/09 share its size and authority-token profile (2.44–2.51 MB, 60 tokens), which is resemblance, not identity.
lineage.appTenantHtml: 0 byte-identical copies in HEAD; one served copy has a tenant-bundle token profile

mayaOsSiteUnreachableReading: NOT PROVEN either way. Its HEAD bytes are served nowhere that was found, but lookalike copies are reachable and a recorded unreachability probe is a production observation that has not been made. K15 requires unreachability to be PROVEN, so K15 still stands open on this point.
